findings.message: No viewport-fit=cover: the browser keeps the page inside the safe area (letterboxed in landscape; env() insets are 0), so bars cannot sit under the notch or home indicator. Choose cover only for an edge-to-edge design, and then pad bars with env()
Targets under 24 px without the spacing exception (WCAG 2.5.8)
Targets under 44 px on a coarse pointer (buttons, fixed-bar links)
Small targets packed closer than 8 px (mis-taps)
Small targets hugging the screen edge, where touch error is largest
Fields that bring the wrong keyboard or miss autofill
examples: (Add a note...): font-size 13.3333px: iOS Safari zooms the page on focus

findings.message: No interactive-widget=resizes-content: the keyboard overlays the page (resizes-visual, the default in Chrome Android and on iOS) and fixed bars stay behind it — check focused fields over a real keyboard on a device
